title: Investigation for facilitation of diagnostics of cerebrospinal fluid in intensive care
summary: This study investigates, if CSF lactate and glucose measurements, which are performed by a blood gas analyzer next to the patient, are valid and therefore may accelerate diagnosing potential infections of continuous drainage systems of cerebrospinal fluid
conditions: Meningitis due to other and unspecified causes

interventions.name: The cerebrospinal fluid of patients with a continuous drainage of cerebrospinal fluid due to increased intracranial pressure will be analyzed with a blood-gas analyzer on a regular Basis.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Presence of continuous lumbar or external ventricular Drainage of cerebrospinal fluid; signed Agreement to participate
Exclusion criteria:
None
